description: A small white cabinet or door-like frame sits near the back-right corner of the tabletop, and a small cube block with an “L” is nearby. The left hand stays resting on the table while the right hand reaches to the cabinet, opens and adjusts it by pulling the front panel outward and shifting the frame slightly, then reaches inside and pulls out the small “L” block and sets it down on the table in front of the cabinet.
